debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d a g-a-l-l-e-r-y o-f d-r-a-f-t b-r-i-e-f-s in the w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y and l-e-f-t a s-h-a-r-e-d i-n-d-e-x p-a-g-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w
2) t-h-e y a c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d s-e-v-e-n s-c-r-i-p-t-s i-n-t-o a s-t-a-n-d-a-l-o-n-e b-i-n-a-r-y b-u-i-l-d and l-e-f-t a c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d e-x-e-c-u-t-a-b-l-e i-n t-h-e t-o-o-l-s f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-a-n-d-b-o-x i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n t-e-s-t
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-e-d s-i-x t-i-m-e-r-s w-i-t-h s-h-o-r-t i-n-t-e-r-v-a-l-s i-n t-h-e s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e r-u-n-n-e-r and l-e-f-t a c-r-o-n t-a-b-l-e e-n-t-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y a-u-d-i-t
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-r-a-c-e-d t-w-o a-p-p-l-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-l-o-w-s f-r-o-m l-o-g-i-n t-o c-h-e-c-k-o-u-t and l-e-f-t a f-l-o-w m-a-p d-i-a-g-r-a-m i-n m-e-m-o-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-a-t-e-l-i-m-i-t c-h-e-c-k
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d t-h-e r-e-p-o-r-t a-s c-l-o-s-e-d i-n t-h-e t-r-a-c-k-e-r and l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l-e-d s-t-a-t-u-s f-l-a-g on the t-i-c-k-e-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-r-c-h-i-v-a-l c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n
